kept.excerpt: For the first time since their title-winning run in 2010, Spain are into the quarter-finals of the FIFA World Cup thanks to Mikel Merino’s late winner to down Portugal 1-0 in the Round of 16 in Dallas. This stage of the tournament had recently become a source of frustration for La Roja, who bowed out in penalties at both Russia 2018 and Qatar 2022 in the last 16 to Russia and Morocco, respectively.
kept.relevance: This cutoff-day official report confirms that Portugal–Spain was settled without a shootout, using up another knockout opportunity without increasing the count.

kept.excerpt: Egypt overcame Australia 4-2 in a penalty shootout to advance to the Round of 16 after a closely contested 1-1 draw in Dallas on Friday. Egypt had gained an early lead in the game through Emam Ashour but Mohamed Hany’s second-half own goal meant a tight game went all the way to penalties.
kept.relevance: This official match report establishes one completed match that qualifies toward the five-shootout threshold.

kept.excerpt: Morocco reached the round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup after a dramatic penalty shootout victory over the Netherlands in Monterrey. The Atlas Lions won 3-2 on penalties after the match finished 1-1 following extra time, with Yassine Bounou again proving decisive on the biggest stage.
kept.relevance: The continental governing body's dated report establishes another completed qualifying shootout.

kept.excerpt: Germany and Paraguay battled for 120 minutes but Gustavo Alfaro's men held their nerve in the penalty shootout to secure a historic victory. After 120 minutes, Paraguay overcame four-time world champions Germany on penalties to progress to the Round of 16 at the FIFA World Cup 2026. Germany 1-1 Paraguay (PSO 3-4).
kept.relevance: This official report establishes a third distinct completed qualifying shootout before the cutoff.

kept.excerpt: Two of the first four matches in the round of 32 were settled by shootouts: Morocco beat the Netherlands and Paraguay bested Germany. A record five games at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar were settled by penalty kicks, including the final when Argentina beat France.
kept.relevance: This contemporary explanatory report connects early 2026 shootout incidence with the previous tournament's five-match record.

kept.excerpt: Five games were decided by penalty kicks at the World Cup in Qatar. By comparison, there were four shootouts at the World Cup in 1990, 2006, 2014 and 2018.
kept.relevance: The historical counts provide a multi-tournament baseline for assessing how demanding a five-shootout threshold is.

kept.excerpt: The FIFA Council unanimously approved the proposed amendment to the FIFA World Cup 2026 competition format from 16 groups of three to 12 groups of four with the top two and eight best third-placed teams progressing to a round of 32. The revised format mitigates the risk of collusion and ensures that all the teams play a minimum of three matches, while providing balanced rest time between competing teams.
kept.relevance: The official introduction of a round of 32 expands the number of knockout matches available to produce shootouts relative to earlier 32-team tournaments.

kept.excerpt: FIFA has revealed the match schedule for the FIFA World Cup 26, with the final to be held in New York New Jersey on Sunday, 19 July 2026 and the opening match featuring the Mexican national team scheduled to be played at the iconic Mexico City Stadium on Thursday, 11 June 2026. Miami will host the bronze final, while Dallas and Atlanta will stage the semi-finals. The schedule ensures that three days of rest for teams is observed for 103 of the tournament’s 104 matches.
kept.relevance: This dated official schedule establishes the planned tournament endpoint and later knockout fixtures that remain relevant at the July 6 forecast date.

search_notes: Frozen evidence cutoff: 2026-07-06, inclusive of sources bearing that publication date. Eight items retained with explicit publication dates visible in search results; NBC's original publication and pre-cutoff update dates are both recorded. The pack establishes three distinct completed shootouts through individual dated reports, but does not assert that these constitute an exhaustively verified total as of the end of July 6. Undated pages, later reports, rolling full-tournament results pages, and betting or prediction-market sources were excluded. Some search results exposed later material; none of those developments or the eventual outcome is included. web_fetch failed because multiple providers were registered; the requested agent-reach web-read fallback returned RATE_LIMITED and was stopped, so verification relies on dated article text exposed by web_search rather than successful direct page retrieval.
